name: AT-LS
description: Integrates Drupal content translation with the AT-LS (www.at-ls.com) translation service via an Advanced Queue + state-machine workflow.

suggests.drupal/yaml_editor: Provides an embeddable code editor for yaml.

project_description: AT-LS integrates Drupal's content translation system with the AT-LS (www.at-ls.com / atls-global.com) professional and automatic translation service. It maps Drupal langcodes to AT-LS ISO 639-2 codes, lets an administrator map which entity types/bundles and fields are translatable, and then sends their source text to AT-LS for translation. Two content entity types (at_ls_translation_request and at_ls_string) track work; requests are processed asynchronously through an Advanced Queue job and a state_machine workflow. Synchronous translations return inline; asynchronous (professional) translations are polled or delivered back through an AT-LS callback, after which the translated values are written back onto the Drupal entity as a new translation. API keys are held per source language through the Key module. Optionally, translation requests can be created automatically when configured translatable entities are inserted or updated.
